dedupe_keys.name: tasopt jl transport aircraft design model

description: TASOPT.jl is a Julia implementation of the Transport Aircraft and the Environment System Optimization model. It combines simplified aerodynamic, structural, thermodynamic and propulsion equations to estimate and optimize commercial-aircraft designs. The JOSS paper describes additional support for some hydrogen-fuel aircraft concepts and links to external propulsion or emissions tools. Users set mission and vehicle assumptions, so its coverage is an aircraft design case, not a fixed airport network or historical flight period. The public repository, documentation and package instructions are MIT licensed. Results can help compare the performance and energy assumptions assigned to aircraft fleets in aviation-system simulations, including emerging fuel choices. The model itself does not simulate an airport, air-traffic-control system or actual fleet operations. A caveat is that conceptual estimates require later engineering verification before procurement or policy decisions. No directly related catalogue record was established. The project documentation and JOSS summary were inspected; no design run or external emissions coupling was tested.
